_version_log: v0.1 (2026-10-13): written before any passage was categorised. v0.2 (2026-10-13, AFTER the first agreement check showed period kappa 0.35): chapter_periods.csv added as the fallback for period. Theme rules unchanged.
_about: Pre-written descriptive codebook, version 0.1 (written 2026-10-13, BEFORE any removed passage was categorised). Categories describe what a passage is about. They say nothing about why it was removed. Change log must be kept: any later edit to a rule is a new version and both versions are reported.
unit: passage = all removed sentence units that sit in the same text block of the old edition (same chapter file, page, block)
assignment: THEME: count keyword hits per theme (case-insensitive, whole words, each distinct keyword counted once); the theme with most distinct hits wins; ties are broken by the order of themes in this file; zero hits = 'unclassified'. All themes with >=1 hit are also stored (multi-label). PERIOD: explicit keyword rule first, otherwise the median of all years (1000-2029 CE, or 'BCE' markers) mentioned in the passage, otherwise the period assigned to the chapter in chapter_periods.csv, otherwise 'no_period'. FORM: regular-expression rules below, first match wins.

religion_communal.definition: Religious communities, religious practice or institutions, relations and conflict between religious communities, secularism.
religion_communal.include_example: a paragraph on Hindu-Muslim relations after Partition
religion_communal.exclude_example: a paragraph on temple architecture with no reference to worship or community (code art_culture)

caste_social_hierarchy.definition: Caste, varna, jati, untouchability, Dalits, Adivasis/tribes, reservation, social discrimination by birth.
caste_social_hierarchy.include_example: sentences on the hereditary nature of varnas
caste_social_hierarchy.exclude_example: a list of freedom fighters that mentions a person's caste in passing only if no other caste keyword occurs

gender.definition: Women, gender relations, patriarchy, women's movements, family and marriage norms.
gender.include_example: a box on the anti-arrack women's movement (also movements_protest)
gender.exclude_example: a biography of a woman ruler with no discussion of gender

state_politics_institutions.definition: Government, constitution, parliament, courts, elections, political parties, leaders acting in office, federalism, emergency powers.
state_politics_institutions.exclude_example: a description of a medieval court's ceremony (code rulers_court_empire)

rulers_court_empire.definition: Pre-modern and early-modern rulers, dynasties, courts, chronicles, imperial administration and nobility.
rulers_court_empire.include_example: a paragraph on the Akbar Nama and Mughal chronicles

colonial_rule.definition: The East India Company and British Raj: conquest, administration, colonial economy, colonial knowledge and town planning.
colonial_rule.include_example: a section on town planning in colonial Calcutta
colonial_rule.exclude_example: nationalist responses to colonial rule (code nationalism_freedom)

nationalism_freedom.definition: The national movement, its leaders and organisations, independence and the making of the nation, Partition.
nationalism_freedom.include_example: the paragraph on reactions to Gandhi's assassination

movements_protest.definition: Collective action outside formal party politics: social, peasant, labour, environmental, students' and regional movements, agitations and strikes.
movements_protest.exclude_example: the 1857 revolt as a military event with no reference to participants' aims (still code here if 'revolt'/'rebellion' is the only hit)

economy_development.definition: Economic policy and conditions: planning, agriculture, industry, trade, poverty, land reform, globalisation.
economy_development.include_example: the eight pages on the Five Year Plans
economy_development.exclude_example: the Russian Revolution as a political event (code international_war)

international_war.definition: Relations between states, wars, alliances, international organisations, the Cold War, foreign policy, world history outside South Asia.
international_war.exclude_example: wars between pre-modern Indian kingdoms (code rulers_court_empire)

art_culture_knowledge.definition: Art, architecture, literature, film, language, education, science and ideas treated as culture.
art_culture_knowledge.include_example: the box on the film Pather Panchali
art_culture_knowledge.exclude_example: religious texts discussed for doctrine (code religion_communal)

science_environment.definition: Natural science content, technology, environment and natural resources.
science_environment.exclude_example: the Narmada dam protests (also movements_protest; whichever has more hits wins)

world_non_south_asia.definition: Passage is about places outside South Asia and names no South Asian period marker

no_period.definition: No period can be assigned by the rules

forms.exercise_question: ends with '?' or starts with a number/bullet followed by an imperative (Discuss, Explain, Write, Find out, Compare, Describe, Mention, State, Why, What, How, Which, Do you)
forms.heading_label: fewer than 6 words and no full stop
forms.body_or_box_text: everything else (font name in the units file separates main text from boxes; see README)
